comment: The maker's site is dead, so everything here comes from the installed 2.2.5 build and from the rendered panels. Two menu items exist in the whole plugin and both are printed with a trailing colon before their checkmark: Old Model (obsolete) on Snare Drum and Model 2 on Deep. The lines drop the colon. Soft Bell, Hi Hat and Frequency Divider add nothing to the right-click menu. Panel jack labels read off the renders: TRIG, ACCENT and OUT on Snare Drum and Soft Bell; TRIG, ACC., OUT and CHOKE on Deep; two TRIG jacks with one ACCENT between them on Hi Hat.
